description: Use this whenever the user asks which AI model to use for a workload. It considers the OpenRouter model catalog and adds Artificial Analysis benchmark data when confidently matched, while returning explicit source freshness metadata if a refresh is degraded. Zero Data Retention is optional and must only be enforced when the user explicitly requires ZDR. After calling this tool, YOU must make the recommendation based on the user use case; do not simply pick the first model or a single benchmark winner. Clearly attribute Artificial Analysis benchmark metrics and OpenRouter catalog/endpoint data.

force_refresh.description: Force fresh upstream API requests. Use sparingly because AA Free has a quota.

max_input_price.description: Maximum acceptable OpenRouter input price in USD per 1M tokens.

max_output_price.description: Maximum acceptable OpenRouter output price in USD per 1M tokens.

requires_tools.description: True when the workload requires tool/function calling.

requires_zdr.description: Set true only when the user explicitly requires Zero Data Retention (ZDR). Otherwise leave false so all OpenRouter models remain eligible.

use_case.description: What the user needs the model to do. Preserve their actual workload and priorities in detail.

name: recommend_models
